messages:
Nina K: Quick heads-up: Pegasus pilot with LangChain + LlamaIndex + Gateway is ready for partner preview next week. Need checklist for marketplace, HW partner notes, and SI handoff.
Sam T: Nice. Who's owning the marketplace entry? I can handle the technical blurb and architecture diagram.
Ravi P: I'll take SI handoff + runbook. Need to confirm whether the gateway uses client-side key or brokered token for marketplace demo.
Courtney L: Marketing wants 2 variants: partner-only preview copy + public launch copy. Partner quote from SI by Tue.
Nina K: Marketplace token: brokered token for demo env. Ops will provide ephemeral partner tokens. Ravi, add token generation steps.
Sam T: Tech blurb draft: "Pegasus integrates Redwood Gateway with LangChain pipelines and LlamaIndex embeddings; supports fallback routing to quantized models for low-cost inference." Will drop file in shared drive.
Ravi P: SI runbook items: install adapter, configure fallback policy, verify model routing, migrate embedding stores. I'll include a short migration snippet for customers moving from "VendorY".
Courtney L: For announcements: propose partner preview Apr 10, internal partner-only Apr 8, public Apr 20 (if no blockers). Need final assets by Apr 4.
partners-bot: Reminder: complete partner checklist form: https://forms.redwood/pegasus (deadline Apr 2)
Sam T: HW partner note: Pegasus has an optional optimized kernel build for H100/GPU partner. Need to state that customers on partner HW may see 2-3x token/sec. I'll add a short note.
Nina K: Ops ask: can we get a sandbox URL with <=2 concurrent users limit for demos? Keeps costs low.
Ravi P: Yes, will set sandbox limit and include rollback steps in runbook. Also adding healthcheck snippet: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://sandbox.redwood/pegasus/health
```
Courtney L: Also want a 15s demo script for sales ops: "Ask a customer question -> LangChain orchestrator hits LlamaIndex embeddings -> Redwood Gateway serves efficient model -> fallback to small model if latency rises." Keep under 15s.
Sam T: I'll produce the architecture PNG + quickstart code sample (LangChain loader + gateway auth) by Thu EOD.
Nina K: Owners recap: Sam = marketplace assets; Ravi = SI runbook + sandbox config; Courtney = announcement copy + demo script; Nina = rollout coordination + partner comms. React with :white_check_mark: when accepted.
Ravi P: :white_check_mark:
Sam T: :white_check_mark:
Courtney L: :white_check_mark:
Nina K: Thanks. I'll compile a one-pager and upload to the shared drive tomorrow morning.
